name: Simonyi Survey Telescope, Cerro Pachón
notes: Other published values: the Ivezić et al. LSST overview paper gives S 30° 14′ 40.68″, W 70° 44′ 57.90″, elevation 2652 m (Mamajek 2012); the NOIRLab Rubin Seeing Monitor page, a different instrument, gives 2612 m. The NOIRLab Simonyi page is used as the official facility source.

summary.plain: The summit dome on Cerro Pachón in northern Chile that houses the 8.4-metre Simonyi Survey Telescope of the Rubin Observatory.
summary.technical: Position of the Simonyi Survey Telescope on El Peñón, Cerro Pachón, Chile (30.245 S, 70.749 W, 2663 m), host of the LSST Camera.
